skills.name: explore-unknowns
skills.description: Map agent-task unknowns before long-horizon work with a four-quadrant knowns/unknowns walk, blindspot pass, decision-first plan, implementation notes, sample-run proof, and merge quiz.

skills.name: write-through-problems
skills.description: Write through messy problems before premature convergence: preserve raw thoughts, transform reactions and ideas, map subproblem islands and edges, diffuse, recurse, and graduate into a decision artifact.

skills.name: cognitive-render
skills.description: Write summaries, briefs, status updates and root-cause analyses that a reader understands on the first read: answer first, who did what to what, concise but never compressed, no invented labels, with a deterministic verifier.

skills.name: explaining-with-html
skills.description: Turn substantial agent answers into one self-contained HTML page: the answer and one picture first, a figure per section, short captions, proof folded into expanders, and a checked 1,200 visible-word budget.

plugins.name: sf-learning
plugins.description: Learns writing rules from your own conversations: captures each prompt with the reply it reacts to into a local, redacted corpus, and proposes reviewed rule changes to the writing skills. Never edits a skill file without your approval.
